content: प्रबोधः .²1 Awaking (<ab>fig.</ab> also), awakening; regaining oneʼs consciousness, consciousness; अप्रबोधाय सुष्वाप <ls>R. 12. 50</ls>; मोहादभूत् कष्टतरः प्रबोधः <ls n="R.">14. 56</ls>. .²2 Blowing, expanding (of flowers) .²3 Wakefulness, sleeplessness; चिरप्रबोधान्न संभावितं धर्मासनमध्यासितुम् <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. .²4 Vigilance, watchfulness. .²5 Knowledge, understanding, wisdom, removal of delusion, real knowledge; as in प्रबोधचन्द्रोदय; सूतात्मजाः सवयसः प्रथितप्रबोधम् <ls>R. 5. 65</ls>. .²6 Consolation. .²7 Reviving the fragrance of a perfume. .²8 Explaining.
